custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Start on the Settings page of the test location.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No setting in any group turns the Active and Inactive tabs, part status or part tracking on or off.

Step 2:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • Location B's Inventory page also shows the Active and Inactive tabs, with Active selected: the feature is on there too, with no setting.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S1-R5b: “The feature is on for every shop on the day of release. There is no rollout setting.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
